hypothesis: A Vietnamese-specialized bi-encoder on a Vietnamese corpus will improve monolingual semantic retrieval relative to the previous cross-lingual setup.
model_comparison_policy: If a model bake-off is run, use Dev only on identical B chunks and queries. Freeze one model before the official A/B/C evaluation. Never use Test to choose a model.
official_strategy_control: Official A/B/C must use one frozen corpus, model, vector store, cosine metric and benchmark; A-B changes chunking and B-C changes only metadata filtering.
holdout_policy: Create and checksum a new Dev/Test split before any retrieval. Run Test once only after model and strategy freeze.
previous_results_policy: The English-corpus CP5 commit 7c311d6 remains the historical baseline and is not overwritten or presented as directly comparable difficulty.
